name: Alba Energy of Katy
old_description: Homeowners who go solar may be eligible to earn up to 30% of their system cost in Investment Tax Credit from the Federal Government.
about:
Alba Energy of Katy operates from its office at 1773 Westborough Drive in Katy, Texas. The company is part of a broader network with locations in Austin, Dallas, Houston, McAllen, and San Antonio, serving the greater Houston area including Brookshire, Sugar Land, and surrounding communities. No founding year or ownership details are publicly disclosed.

The firm specializes in residential solar panel installation and related services. Its offerings include site assessment, system design, installation, and ongoing production monitoring. Alba Energy promotes zero-upfront-cost options and financing programs structured to deliver savings from the first month. Each installation is backed by a 25-year manufacturer's warranty on equipment.

The primary customer base consists of homeowners in Texas seeking to reduce electricity costs through solar power. The company assists clients in claiming the federal investment tax credit, which can cover up to 30% of system costs. Service territories center on the CenterPoint Energy footprint in the Houston region.

Alba Energy differentiates itself with a "Peace-of-Mind Production Monitoring" platform, bilingual Spanish-English support, and a focus on customer education. Testimonials highlight reduced monthly bills and responsive service.
built_on: Smart financing programs with day-one savings
type_evidence: Looking for a solar panel installer in Katy, Texas? Then look no further. Alba Energy is a premier solar installer in the Centerpoint Energy service territory and a top-rated company in Katy, Texas.
